ns2:course.label: Dostoevsky
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the major work of Fyodor Mikhailovich Dostoevsky. No Russian required. Same as CWL 324. Prerequisite: At least one other college literature course or consent of instructor. This course may be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours.
